{"metadata":{"description":"Session settings, MCP servers, and Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.","id":"gh:1336634168","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-session-settings","slug":"u9521/dsh-session-settings","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Session settings, MCP servers, and Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-session-settings"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Session Settings, MCP Server, and Skill Management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Configure per-session or global settings directly from the Web GUI with immediate effect:
1. **Subag"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ent Model & Reasoning Effort**: Independently configure provider, model, and reasoning effort for su"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"bagents (`subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `workflow`).
2. **Centralized MCP Server Management**: First-c"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"lass sidebar navigation item for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with 2-stage compatibility pro"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"bing, automatic protocol downgrade, tool schema inspection, and read-only browsing of resources and "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"prompts.
3. **Session-Level MCP Tool Control**: Granularly enable/disable MCP servers and specific t"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ools per session or follow global defaults.
4. **Session-Level Skill Management & Control**: Indepen"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"dently enable/disable bundled, user, and project skills per session, with automatic dynamic prompt c"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"atalog filtering and execution enforcement."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Settings Sidebar Navigation Entry**: Top-level section in Settings navigation sidebar (dedicated"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" icon) for direct MCP server management.
- **Session-Specific Tab**: Dedicated tab in the conversati"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"on view for configuring the active session's subagent models, MCP tools, and skills.
- **Switch-Base"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"d Subagent Control**: Three explicit switches — allow agents to choose a subagent model, replace the"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" model of forked subagents, and specify a subagent model with its reasoning effort.
- **Instant Effe"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ct**: Each agent's scope layers are re-declared on save and on tool-registry changes, so an updated "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"policy applies on the very next request without restarting DSH.
- **Three Explicit Scopes**: Session"},{"id":"p7s8","text":", Workspace, and Global are distinct write targets chosen on the page, never inferred from which fie"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"lds a request happens to carry.
- **New-Session Page Targets a Live Session**: Choosing a workspace "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"on the New-Session page connects that workspace's blank session, and the modal writes session-scope "},{"id":"p7s11","text":"edits straight to it — effective on the next request. A page with no session has no session scope to"},{"id":"p7s12","text":" write to, so that tab disables itself and explains why.
- **Single Interface Contract**: Paths, HTT"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"P methods, and request bodies are each declared once in `src/types.ts`; the client sends and the ser"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"ver validates against the same definitions, with no server-side compatibility branches.
- **One Reso"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"lution Ladder**: The session → workspace → global rules and their defaults live in `src/shared/`, sh"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ared by the panel that displays them and the server that enforces them, so a panel cannot show one v"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"alue while enforcement uses another.
- **Authenticated Routes**: All routes are registered on the of"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"ficial connection carrier, so a request passes the Host/Origin fence and browser authentication befo"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"re any handler runs.
